mapper.sql: RESERVATION_ID, RESERVATION_NO, REQUEST_ID, STATUS, PAY_STATUS, MOVE_DATE, MOVE_TIME, MOVE_MEMO, APPLIED_AT, DEPOSIT_PAID_AT, CANCELLED_AT, CANCELLED_BY
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_RESERVATION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_RESERVATION (RESERVATION_ID, RESERVATION_NO, REQUEST_ID, STATUS, PAY_STATUS, MOVE_DATE, MOVE_TIME) VALUES (#{reservationId}, 'ME-' || TO_CHAR(#{moveDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(#{reservationId}, 10000), 4, '0'), #{requestId}, '01', '01', #{moveDate}, #{moveTime})
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.RESERVATION_NO, R.REQUEST_ID, R.STATUS, R.PAY_STATUS, R.MOVE_DATE, R.MOVE_TIME, R.MOVE_MEMO, R.APPLIED_AT, R.DEPOSIT_PAID_AT, R.CANCELLED_AT, R.CANCELLED_BY FROM TBL_RESERVATION R JOIN TBL_MOVE_REQUEST M ON M.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY R.MOVE_DATE, R.RESERVATION_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = '03', CANCELLED_AT = SYSDATE, CANCELLED_BY = #{cancelledBy}, PAY_STATUS = CASE WHEN PAY_STATUS = '01' THEN '03' ELSE PAY_STATUS END WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND STATUS = '01'
UPDATE TBL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = '02' WHERE STATUS = '01' AND MOVE_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM TBL_REVIEW WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId}
